identity.name: US community bank originator (attributed to Cogent Bank, unconfirmed) via FIS-Intain Digital Liquidity Gateway

about.registryInfo: Intain Inc. (founded 2018; IntainADMIN administers >$5.5B across 25+ structured finance deals; ISO 27001). IntainMARKETS runs as a permissioned Avalanche L1 supported by AvaCloud; the FIS-Intain Digital Liquidity Gateway (launched Nov 2025) lets community banks tokenize loans as NFTs reconciled against FIS core-banking data with third-party verification, securitized and sold to institutional investors.
